description: This file contains the minified implementation of the YAHOO.util.History module from Yahoo's YUI library, version 2.9.1, which manages browser history and hash change events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the History module with DOM elements for tracking history.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Changes the current history state programmatically.

methods.name: multiNavigate
methods.description: Performs multiple state navigations in one call.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified module.

methods.name: getBookmarkedState
methods.description: Returns the bookmarked state for a given module name if available.

methods.name: getQueryStringParameter
methods.description: Extracts a specific query string parameter from the URL.
